table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= item.name, 
	accname = dbo.accounts.name, 
	packingdesc=max(item.packingdesc),
	aliasname=max(item.customicode),
	address = max(dbo.customer.address1),
	salesman = dbo.users.username, 
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	headerno = max(dbo.saleledger.headerno),
	headerinvno = max(dbo.saleledger.headerinvno),  
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,	
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	batch = saledetail.batch,   
	expiry = saledetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = isnull(sum(saledetail.looseqty),0),
	packqty  = isnull(sum(saledetail.packqty),0),
	bonusqty  = isnull(sum(saledetail.bonusqty),0),
	packunits= max(saledetail.packunits),
	saleprice= max(saledetail.saleprice),
	discperc = max(saledetail.discperc),
	salestax =max( saledetail.salestax),
	itemflatdisc =max(saledetail.itemflatdisc), 
	itempacking = max(itempacking.name),
	ItemCategory=(SELECT dbo.ItemCategory.Name FROM dbo.ItemCategory WHERE dbo.ItemCategory.ICatCode = Item.ICatCode),
	itemdescription = max(saledetail.saleitemdescription),	
	Godown =max(Godown.name),	
	Id       = max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL) 

FROM 
	saleledger, 
	saledetail, 
	accounts, 
	customer,
	users,  
	Item 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Godown ON (dbo.item.GCode = dbo.Godown.GCode)
 
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
	( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode) 

GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	SaleLedger.CustRefNo,
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks,
	saleledger.custrefno, 
	saledetail.icode,
	saledetail.batch,
	saledetail.expiry,
	saledetail.rowgroup, 
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable, 
	accounts.name,
	Item.ICatCode,
	dbo.users.username
ORDER BY 
	ItemCategory,
	itemname
